title: GSE circular peak geometry three-seed training
purpose: Train the full causal circular structural geometry model on C01-C06, select only on C07, and measure one-shot C08 transfer before descriptor association or graph construction.

approval.scope: One immutable Gate-3 three-seed training: C01-C06 gradients, C07 checkpoint and one threshold selection, C08 one final zero-adaptation evaluation; no C09/C10/M-TARE/graph/planner.
approval.confirmation_reference: User explicitly delegated best-method decisions and continuous execution.

raw_sources: Sealed C01-C08 deduplicated causal LiDAR shards.
Sealed PASS circular peak geometry model readiness.
source.license_or_allowed_use: Local project-generated procedural worlds and objective derived targets.

worlds.fit: Exact Cartesian S01-S10 x C01-C06: 60 worlds and the only gradient source.
worlds.selection: Exact S01-S10 x C07: 10 worlds for checkpoint and threshold selection; exact S01-S10 x C08: 10 worlds for one final transfer evaluation only.
worlds.forbidden: C09, C10 and all M-TARE worlds

sampling.rule: Each fit world is loaded as one immutable shard per epoch; its observations are deterministically shuffled. Each batch receives a deterministic 4-column-lattice circular roll. C07/C08 receive no augmentation or update.

teacher.source: Circular peak presence/residual/width-mask/profile plus objective local axis and width/height/slope/curvature masks.
teacher.use: Train balanced peak presence, uncertainty-aware masked peak geometry, axis and global geometry. Identity and pose are not read; descriptor association is a later separately qualified stage.
teacher.valid_mask: Presence all bins; residual/profile peak bins; width independent valid peak mask; global geometry its four-value mask.
teacher.student_input: Five causal normalized range/valid frames only. Normalization is the frozen sensor maximum 50 m, not fitted data statistics.
teacher.planner_consistency_plan: No node/edge/graph is created; physical traversal remains the only future edge authority.

split.fit: C01-C06 gradients and circular augmentation only.
split.checkpoint_and_threshold_selection: C07 minimum total masked validation loss selects one checkpoint per seed; probability-mean ensemble on C07 selects the maximum-recall local-peak threshold satisfying precision >=0.995.
split.strict_test: C08 is one final zero-adaptation development transfer and cannot alter checkpoints, loss, epochs or threshold. C09/C10/M-TARE remain unread.
split.historical_pollution_audit: Old checkpoints that read C07/C08 are forbidden as initialization and remain baseline-only.

methods.main: Three independently initialized 769268-parameter five-frame circular peak geometry networks and a probability-mean ensemble.
methods.baseline: Frozen raw current-range envelope AP 0.051493 and historical free-query high-precision recall no greater than 0.093888; neither is retrained.
methods.fallback: If safe recall, action cardinality or geometry gates fail on either C07 or C08, stop before association/graph; do not alter epochs, grid, threshold, seed or planner.

acceptance.peak_detection: C07-selected ensemble threshold must give precision >=0.995 and recall >=0.50 on both C07 and C08; AP must exceed raw-range AP by at least 0.10 absolute on both.
acceptance.action_set: Terminal/corridor/junction macro-F1 from stable peak cardinality must be >=0.80 on both C07 and C08.
acceptance.peak_geometry: Matched peak heading MAE <=1 degree, opening-width MAE <=3 m and vertical-profile MAE <=1 m on both splits.
acceptance.global_geometry: Axis mean error <=10 degrees; width/height MAE <=2 m; slope MAE <=2 degrees; curvature MAE <=0.02 per m on both splits.
acceptance.selection: C08 checkpoint observations and updates are exactly zero; all three seeds and the ensemble are reported.

failure_policy: Any system drift stops the run. Any scientific gate failure yields a sealed FAIL and stops this route before graph; no retry, threshold relaxation, seed selection or planner compensation.
retention: Retain three checkpoints, histories, compact C07/C08 raw predictions, per-world metrics, fixed threshold, figures/source, environment, logs, RUN_STATE and seal.

estimated_cost.compute: Three sequential CUDA trainings plus C07 epoch evaluation and one final C07/C08 inference
